column3: Shirley near Jason's house, Key Lento; buy Salty Squid rum at Three Sheets Liquor.
column4:
After Gear Up / Lab Fees / Just a Scratch / Unwanted Attention, help Shirley before Tourist Trap. Buy rum BEFORE asking the shop about strange bird noises (the exotic-animal shootout can shut it). Return to Shirley for reported Focus/criminal-profile benefit. Chapter 1 MISSABLE.
Area sweep (Key Lento): Basketball Hoops - Key Lento - Three Sheets Liquor (ID 4437).
Reported Focus increase: 3% (Act of Kindness).
Shirley’s strand is not part of Strangers & Freaks.

column3: The Rusty Anchor, Key Lento. Cal texts after Day Release, before Swamped.
column4: Say yes to drinks with Cal and Rhonda, then DRIVE CAL HOME. Declining twice or abandoning him fails. Later Cal texts: the bar sells a white Rusty Anchor T-shirt and cap. Chapter 1 ONLY; reward is the option to BUY clothes. GPS map: Rusty Anchor bar venue for the optional mission.\nArea sweep (Key Lento): Cards / Liberty City Penetrators - D'Angelou Miles (ID 717).

column3: Shirley's neighbor Peggy's house across the water in Key Lento; scooter beside the driveway stairs.
column4: After Get Shirley's Rum, wait roughly a day for Shirley to call Jason. Take Peggy's scooter and drive it inside Shirley's porch/house. Chapter 1 ONLY: unavailable at Tourist Trap. No reward reported.\nArea sweep (Key Lento): Standout Vehicles - Imponte Ruiner Turbo (ID 177).\nShirley’s strand is not part of Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Gellhorn Outfitters on west Port Gellhorn beachside.
column4: Lucia gets this automatic side mission after Girls' Trip. Retrieve weapons already stored in locker (free), or buy a gun. Walk out armed to finish; no separate cash reward. GPS map: Gellhorn Outfitters store venue for the optional mission.\nArea sweep (Port Gellhorn): Standout Vehicles - Maibatsu Pharaoh Sanchez (ID 188).

column3: Read pilot flyer beside Starlet Motel office, then go to McKittrick Farm about a mile east.
column4: Lucia: (1) fly Kyle's crop duster over field, three passes ($400 reported); (2) obtain chemicals from guarded compound ($1,000 reported); (3) finish Buddy? police standoff in Chapter 2 or later ($5,000 reported if helping police). Later steps arrive by text; payouts depend on choices. For the chemical delivery, wait for Kyle's text then visit FarmFix on Chastity Avenue north of Belville. Inspect the van. Negotiate > Pay less > Pay now costs $3,000; Negotiate > Pay Later > Give Collateral uses Kyle's plane and costs nothing upfront (reported). Drive the van into the barn by the silo. Eat the offered strawberry for the reported max stamina upgrade; later berries give temporary effects. $1,000 payment is separate. GPS map: Starlet Motel flyer starting point; McKittrick Farm is a separate destination.\nAfter the third stage, a further Farm Fix visit is reported without a text or mission marker.\nBuddy? finale: either protagonist can attend. It may unlock during Chapter 2 after a long wait. Both outcomes count toward Strangers & Freaks; siding with police reportedly pays $5,000, while waiting for Kyle to win pays nothing. (PowerPyx)

column3: Northern Lummox County near Mount Kalaga; Jason receives Bret text after Coffee Break.
column4: JASON ONLY. Meet Bret alone after Coffee Break; take the Killtelligence SM-69 (weapon ID 435). Study and track deer, aim for head or heart for Good or Pristine carcass quality, and transport kills by truck. Bret texts each Target Deck after the prior delivery; see Activities > Bret Target Decks for documented hunts. First reward ~$500 reported. After Veteran Hunted, watch for Bret's rare-animal clues in Activities > Snapmatic Animals. See the Legendary Animals checklist for nine clue hunts and two other rare creatures. Use Focus (L3+R3) to inspect vitals, best weapon and value; Bret buys whole carcasses after this mission. Green dollar icon indicates available drop-off.\nArea sweep (Mount Kalaga): Stunt Jumps / Lummox - West Kalaga Logging (ID 1017).\nFair Game is Bret’s separate trophy; his strand is not part of Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Salton, Vice City: after Bumper to Bumper and Yago's delayed text; Jason only.
column4:
TIME-LIMITED pink hourglass. Meet Santiago, select Freeway Run (second race), rent a car, finish race against Yago. First-place payout reported $3,800, varies by finish. DO THIS promptly when text arrives; a side race before Brother to Brother; do not assume it is required for the trophy. Separate from initial Join a Street Race. GPS map: Salton street-race venue; select the timed Freeway Run event.
Area sweep (Salton): Cards / Vice City Narcos - Antoine Bello (ID 557).
Reported story-order trigger: after Raul’s Next Job; do not wait if the hourglass appears earlier.
Jason only; after Bumper to Bumper and Yago’s message. PowerPyx marks the race missable and Alcast excludes it from required trophy tasks; complete promptly if collecting all optional tasks.

column3: Sundown Private Airfield, Leonard County. Pete calls Jason after Pool Day.
column4:
JASON ONLY. Start Passing the Torch: enter hangar red door backroom, take Pete's KZ-59 from table (weapon ID 442); safe 3718 is separate. Fly cargo drops and return plane. Later Backseat Pilot and Pete's Deliveries follow. Initial $12,000 guide-reported.
Backseat Pilot: seven deliveries from Wild Hog Airfield within two in-game hours; $20,000 on success.
Southpoint delivery: seven drops before 20:00; $20,000 on success.
Avery Allen & Co.: seven drops before 14:00; $20,000 on success. Southpoint and Avery Allen can be done in either order.
Final Leonard County delivery: after both parallel jobs and a later message, seven drops by 08:00; $20,000 on success.
Southpoint: land on the field for the supplier. Avery Allen: water landing near supplier; avoid restricted red circles. Final Leonard delivery: wait for Pete’s message after both parallel deliveries. Completion of the fifth job counts for Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Thrillbilly Mud Club, north Kelly County
column4:
Begin Billy strand: Check Out the Mud Club; unlocks other Mud Club races. GPS map: Thrillbilly Mud Club venue; meet Billy to start the mission.
Area sweep (Thrillbilly Mud Club): Stunt Jumps / Kelly - Mud Club Pond (ID 937).
Selecting the Mud Club during Coffee Break can start Thrillbillies as a main mission.
Reported placement-dependent cash, up to $2,500 for first place.
Billy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.

column3: Port Gellhorn. Wait for Billy to contact you after Thrillbillies.
column4: Join Billy with either character and follow his crew on the dirt bike. Finish the armored van job and follow Billy back. Reported payout $2,000.\nArea sweep (Port Gellhorn): Publications - The Johnsons (Issue 1) (ID 1469).\nBilly’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.

column3: Behind the Malibu, Ocean Beach. Wait for Billy to contact you in Chapter 3 after Twist Wrist.
column4:
Bring Jason or Lucia solo. Follow Billy into the jewelry store and leave in the van. Reported payout $12,000. This is a story job with Billy.
Area sweep (Ocean Beach): Luxury Watches - Novak Laurent Haute Grandeur (ID 5039).
Reported story-order appearance after The Missing Link.
Billy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.

column3: Ambrosia Police Department impound, Kelly County.
column4:
After Mall Rats, wait for Billy to call, then reply to Wyman's text. Take the police Impaler, lose the police and deliver it to the tunnel. Either character can start.
Area sweep (Ambrosia): Small Bank Jobs - Shorefront - Ambrosia (ID 495).
No direct cash reward reported.
Billy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.

column3: Thrillbilly Mud Club, Kelly County. Follow Billy's text after The Impaler.
column4: Return to the mud club for Billy's finale. The reported reward is $10,000 and The Lone Rider trophy or achievement.\nArea sweep (Thrillbilly Mud Club): Unique Race Wins - Thrillbilly Dirt: Trash Dash (ID 5151).\nBilly’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.

column3: Andy's new house, Belville. Wait for a call and address text as Lucia after Mami Knows Best and Car Service.
column4: Finish the three Climbing the Cellerichain deliveries. Andy gives Lucia the Pure Manifestick and Cellerica cap welcome package.\nArea sweep (Belville): Cards / Los Santos Corkers - Franklin Turner (Bronze) (ID 794).\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: Lucia's phone, anywhere. Wait for Andy after finishing all three Cellerichain parts.
column4: Pay the reported $5,000 initiation fee through BuckMe. Switch to Lucia to receive the call.\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: Andy Cellerica initiation, Lucia only
column4: After paying Andy's fee, wait for his text as Lucia. At the Belville Cellerica campus, look outside Conference Hall B for the green Cellerica Caddy that Andy introduces.\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: Vice City. Cecilia sends the location to Lucia after Peach!, following an in-game delay.
column4: Recover the marked Cellerica van and drive it to Cecilia's warehouse. Reported payout $1,800 through BuckMe.\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: Start at the Paper Boys warehouse after Cecilia contacts Lucia. The mission continues at Cecilia's mansion.
column4: Finish Read the Label first. Complete the warehouse sequence and find Cecilia at her mansion. Reported reward $10,000 and the Road to Rehabilitation trophy or achievement.\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: After Boobie Time, look for Yasmani's job markers at Casa de Empeno, Richardson Jewelry and Donovan Banks & Co.
column4: Either character can take the jobs. Objective items unlock the Snap Gun and paid garage pickups. The reported objective-item payout is $20,000 plus any other proceeds.\nYasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Yasmani ATM jobs
column4: After Jewelry Jobs and Credit Check, either character receives the initial free robbery tip. The three full ATMs are Megamart, Casino and Xero Gas. The opportunity lasts one in-game day; missing it does not prevent subsequent paid tips. Borrow Yasmani’s 86 Rancher with a winch behind his shop or use an eligible winch vehicle. Each ATM has four cash trays. Reported combined proceeds $30,000–$40,000 (PowerPyx, Nov 27).\nYasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Yasmani payday loan jobs
column4: Rob 2 payday loans to unlock security-van tip service.\nOptional follow-up: after at least one payday-loan tip, ask for more tips to trigger Steal the Gold Blammer. The necklace is in the locked desk box at Vice City Gun & Pawn, Rockridge. Reported payout $15,000. Do this before That’s Where the Money Is if you want the optional job; skipping it does not block progression.\nYasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Yasmani side job
column4: Tail the Security Van. Later pay for tips to attempt the large vaults. The Chapter 3 strand is distinct from the Chapter 4 bank-vault tutorial; some guides group the later tips with the latter.\nYasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Tyrone / Kitty Litter Labs
column4: Take Out Kitty Litter: start lab-closure strand.\nTyrone’s strand has its own Spin On This! trophy, not Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Grayson, Lummox County. Jason receives the follow-up after closing enough Kitty Litter labs.
column4:
Meet Tyrone at the motel and finish his lab operation. Reported reward $10,000 and the Spin On This! trophy or achievement.
Area sweep (Grayson): Standout Vehicles - Bravado Third Eye Youga (ID 145).
PC Gamer reports that Tyrone calls after 15 labs have been destroyed.
After the finale, Tyrone calls to offer his gold W-10 sidearm variant; collect it at his apartment.
Tyrone offers the highest reported narcotics buy rate after the lab storyline.
Tyrone supplies additional drug-theft locations. The source did all labs and the finale, so whether the latter alone unlocks these benefits is uncertain.
Tyrone’s strand has its own Spin On This! trophy, not Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Dunk robbery tip marker
column4: Guide reports optional robberies from Dunk; use in-game markers for individual tips. Reported Chapter 3 markers follow the earlier introduction to Dunk; use the Robberies map filter. The full reward and completion requirements remain uncertain.

column3: Gambit Bay, Mariana County, after Feng Shui. Play as Jason.
column4: Catch a stoplight parrotfish weighing more than 2 lb for Cal. The guide reports a Focus increase and the Baited My Tackle trophy or achievement.\nNot one of the eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Heathcliff Heights party at the Y Hotel, Ocean Beach, during Pool Day. Attend with one playable character.
column4:
Meet Eddie at the elevator. The published guide reports that agreeing to pay him costs $50,000. Refusing avoids the payment.
Area sweep (Ocean Beach): Standout Vehicles - Piccia Dragon Gate Furia (ID 2300).
Reported availability after Bad Driver!; attend solo.
Not one of the eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Hamlet, Vice-Dale County, after Lawyer Up. Lucia only.
column4:
Time-sensitive. Pick up Shayna and drive her home. The outcome and reported valuables depend on the choices at Raph's house.
Area sweep (Hamlet): Standout Vehicles - LCC Midnight Sun Avarus (ID 183).
Reported story-order appearance after Child’s Play.
Lucia only. Earliest reported trigger: after Lawyer Up, drive near Hamlet and respond to Shayna’s message. Pick her up at prison. Optional house valuables ~ $1,500; reported peaceful outcome ~ $1,200, higher-risk outcome up to $5,000 in fenceable items. No trophy requirement.

column2: Ch4: That's Where the Money Is
column3: Cafe Orquidea, Ocean Beach, after VCIA Takedown.
column4:
Either character can meet Yasmani's marker. Follow the security van, enter the bank and finish the vault tutorial to unlock eight large-bank vault jobs.
Reported story-order appearance after Tie Up Loose Ends.
Before starting this tutorial, complete any desired Gold Blammer and small-bank tip jobs: they may be bypassed afterward. Small-bank tips become available in Chapter 4 after previous tips; Yasmani provides safe codes for a fee. The reported typical safe payout is about $20,000. These optional jobs are not required for completion.
Yasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Salton, Vice City: after Dealer's Choice; Manuel texts Jason with the Hit n Run VC street-race marker.
column4: Open Yago questline. Rent a car and finish Join a Street Race. Introduces Yago; after a few in-game days unlocks Bumper to Bumper (ID 1444), then timed race (ID 1413), then Brother to Brother (ID 1445). GPS map: Salton Hit N Run VC race venue; follow the quest marker.\nArea sweep (Salton): Cards / Delights Dancers - Tracy (ID 999).\nYago’s qualifying strand awards credit at Brother to Brother, not each individual race.

column3: Little Cuba, Vice City: Yago's street shop; Jason only. Wait several in-game days after Join a Street Race.
column4:
If marker is locked, sleep/return later. Drive Yago's 1990 Annis Elegy to Euroform Automotive; select Pro Builds > Full Kits > Custom Street Racing Build, then Performance > Boost > Nitrous Boost. Yago pays. Finish race, lose cops and meet Yago north of Vice City. Reward $500. Later he texts about the MISSABLE limited race ID 1413.
Area sweep (Little Cuba): Standout Vehicles - Annis Yago's Elegy (ID 3603).
Reported story-order appearance after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs; Jason only.
Yago’s qualifying strand awards credit at Brother to Brother, not each individual race.

column3: El Rincon Notorio restaurant BACK DOOR, Little Cuba, Vice City. Yago texts after earlier races; Jason only.
column4: Final Yago mission, after Yago’s earlier missions; the limited Race Against Yago (ID 1413) is separately missable; delayed a few in-game days. Back him at deal in west Vice City, take bag, fight through gang and follow his car. End choice does not save Yago. Reward: KEEP his custom anime-wrapped Annis Yago's Elegy, Standout ID 3603; garage it or sell at Pay n Spray. Bag contains marked bills to fence; no direct cash payout. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.\nArea sweep (Little Cuba): Cards / Liberty City Penetrators - Lamont Berry (ID 726).\nReported story-order appearance after Mall Rats; Jason only.

column3: Freddie's compound on the north shore of Lake Leonida, Leonard County. Either character.
column4: PowerPyx reports the east container/tunnel entrance for the initial visit and the northeast water tower for the retest. VGC reports the water tower on the initial visit, then a northwest tractor/trailer ramp on the retest if the tower is closed. Use whichever in-game entrance is accessible. Wait for Freddie's invitation between visits. Either choice completes the mission and unlocks hurricane weather (PowerPyx). Reward conflict: PowerPyx reports $10,000; VGC reports $6,250 cash for leaving or a gold Benefactor Dubsta for staying. To pursue the vehicle, stay with Freddie; verify the actual award. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.\nA newer report recommends waiting several in-game days for the second invitation; the first-visit route uses the east-side loader/container entrance. Hurricane weather becomes available after the retest, not necessarily immediately.

column3: Meet the roadside protesters south of Vice City International Airport. Noah's follow-up is in northwest Southside by the river.
column4: Give Noah your details and wait for his text. Go alone as Jason or Lucia. Photograph the animals with the phone and follow Noah until you deliver the cage.\nArea sweep (Southside): Cards / Liberty City Wrath - James Bowery (Deep Red) (ID 768).

column3: Vice City Oceanarium, Catalan Key. Speak to Rosebud among the protesters, then meet at her marker south of the buildings.
column4: Give Rosebud your details and wait for her message. Use Jason or Lucia solo. Follow her through the Oceanarium and drive the orca transport to the marked drop-off.\nArea sweep (Catalan Key): WAiNK Curiosities - Mermaid Display (ID 1304).\nNo separate mission reward listed in the published walkthrough.

column3: Watson Bay, Mariana County. Meet Tyler as Lucia after Bring Out the Chimp and Sisters of the Sea.
column4: Follow Tyler to the fracking site. Complete the valve and drill objectives, then leave with him. His follow-up opens the final Dodos mission.\nArea sweep (Watson Bay): Cards / Los Santos Corkers - Jonah Clemmons (Silver) (ID 798).\nNo separate mission reward listed in the published walkthrough.

column3: Emerald Springs park, Kelly County. Lucia only, after Twin Flames.
column4: Follow the green arrows toward the glass building on the park island. Take the egg to Jeff and finish the marked stops with the dodo before delivering it to Yvonne. Reported payout $5,000.\nArea sweep (Emerald Springs): WAiNK Landmarks - Sky Ride (ID 1256).\nAt the vet, the reported prompt to resist the knockout is Square / X repeatedly.

column3: Park at the south end of Ocean Beach. A poster in the Bayside Apartment lobby points to the event.
column4: Talk to the stuntman in white as Jason or Lucia. Set up the stunt and meet the AudaCity engineer afterward to start Papa Audacity's strand.\nNo direct reward reported. Give Details to the engineer; the follow-up arrives after a few in-game days.\nPapa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column3: La Perle, Vice City. After The Unknown Stuntman, wait for the message and return as the same character.
column4:
Meet the AudaCity engineer. Finish the marked dirt-bike tests, including the final leap, and speak to the engineer again.
Area sweep (La Perle): Standout Vehicles - Declasse Tap-Tap Walton (ID 2377).
Avoid pink box stacks on the lower course; aim for a multiplier over x50 on the roof within about a minute. No direct reward reported.
The waiting dirt bike is reported as AudaCity Sanchez (GTABase). Lower parking level course, then roof: large central jumps initially add x10; final corner ramp lands in water. Retention after the trial is not established.
Papa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column2: Ch3: Quit Your Job, Sell Your House
column3: Peacock Bay Condominiums. After Trial by Tire, bring both Jason and Lucia to Papa Audacity's marker.
column4:
Go to the roof, help with the aerial stunt and bring Papa Audacity to the medical center. The AudaCity Sandking is a reported keep-or-sell reward.
Area sweep (Peacock Bay): Knife Flights - Peacock Bay Luxury Condominiums East (ID 1111).
After the Catalan Key skydive and stadium incident, carry Papa to the truck in the parking lot and drop him at Brooks Healthcare Medical Center, Southside. Keep the truck or sell it; reported $4,400 registration, buyer offer varies.
Alternate walkthrough: enter the checkerboard-floor lobby, take the elevator, climb yellow stairs to the helipad, then follow the pink aerial ring over Catalan Key. At the purple stadium court, stand on the ground beneath the canopy for the filming angle before retrieving the truck.
Papa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column3: Use the marked AudaCity vehicles around Vice City after Quit Your Job, Sell Your House.
column4:
Finish the five dirt-bike jumps, then complete the two follow-up stunts that appear. Follow the mission markers for the full series.
First five stunts can be done in any order: Dalton statue, Leonida Power and Light, Ocean Beach garage, St. Vitus and Mastodon Sand Mill. Follow-ups: Piker Financial Center and Vice City sign. No direct reward reported.
Alternate AudaCity Sandking sighting at the West Vice-Dale Vice City Sign stunt ramp: reported scan lists Key Cloner, alarm, no tracker, $10,350 sell value and $4,400 registration. Do not count the alternate spawn as a second variant.
Detailed mission routes: Dalton sculpture from the back; LPL dirt ramp north over the canal; Ocean Beach garage roof south toward alley; St. Vitus rooftop northeast corner; Mastodon purple circle beyond yellow container and mixer. Downtown follow-up: elevator, parachute and rings. Airport follow-up: western ramps over boats toward Vice City sign. Use mission cues; these are not the 130 free-roam jumps.
Papa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column3: Sundown Airfield, Waning Sands, Leonard County. Unlocks after completing the AudaCity stunts.
column4: Meet Papa Audacity at the airfield. Follow the flight route, climb to the marked altitude and parachute onto the yacht.\nArea sweep (Waning Sands): Cards / Los Santos Pounders - Maximus Goldbart (Yellow) (ID 873).\nPapa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column3: Neo Paloma Apartments, Tequesta. Papa Audacity sends the party invitation after Catching a Whale.
column4:
Find the engineers by the elevator. Sell DacityCoin through the phone before the final jump to receive the reported payout. Finish the party escape for Strangers & Freaks credit.
Area sweep (Tequesta): Standout Vehicles - Buckingham Avalanche Supervolito (ID 2319).
Reported proceeds roughly $22,350 in the elevator or $25,250 immediately before the final jump. The coin crashes if held through the finale. Party invitation follows about one in-game day after Catching a Whale.
Either character can attend. After the rooftop pool landing, use the building on the opposite side of the pool to reach the elevator; call Papa after losing the wanted level to finish the strand.
